top_concerns: No seeds or variance reported; ablations (e.g., layer choice, LIBERO-Long 83-94) look noisy and the ~1.4-pt LIBERO gain may be within noise
Inconsistent baselines: 1xH100 ablation baseline (92.7%) is far below official OpenVLA-OFT (97.1%); training-speed and data-efficiency claims use this weaker baseline
No same-model comparison with explicit depth/VGGT input or other 3D-aware targets; SigLIP/DINOv2 alignment also helps, so the 'spatial' attribution is weakly supported
Depth probing is qualitative and somewhat circular; mechanistic claims (shortcut avoidance, spatial comprehension) are untested
Incremental novelty (REPA/3DRS-style alignment); small real-world evaluation (20-40 trials, one platform, no 3D VLA baselines)
